rows.note: Sales and use tax on taxable prices of $1 or more: 6 cents per exact dollar (a bracket schedule applies to the cents). Since 1 July 2025 data, IT and software publishing services (NAICS 518, 519, 5132, 5415) are taxed at 3%.
rows.source_title: Tax-General § 11-104: Sales and use tax rates
rows.label: State sales tax rate

rows.note: Exempt: food for consumption off the premises sold by a vendor operating a substantial grocery or market business (with the statute's exceptions).
rows.source_title: Tax-General § 11-206: Food
rows.label: Groceries (food for home consumption)

rows.note: Exempt: sales of medicine, and drugs or medical supplies sold to or by a physician or hospital.
rows.source_title: Tax-General § 11-211: Medical items
rows.label: Prescription drugs

rows.note: Taxable purchases on which no sales tax was paid (storage, use or consumption in the state). Tax-General § 11-104 sets one sales and use tax rate.
rows.source_title: Tax-General § 11-104: Sales and use tax rates
rows.label: Use tax rate

rows.note: Remote seller's gross revenue from sales delivered into Maryland, previous or current calendar year: must collect above this amount. Either test triggers collection.

rows.note: Remote seller's separate transactions for delivery into Maryland, previous or current calendar year. Counted in transactions. Either test triggers collection.
rows.source_title: Tax Updates from the 2025 Legislative Session (webinar presentation)
rows.label: Remote sellers: transactions threshold

rows.note: Maryland estate tax exemption amount (decedents dying on or after 1 January 2019), plus any deceased spousal unused exclusion amount.
rows.source_title: Maryland Code, Tax-General § 7-309: Estate tax
rows.label: Estate tax: exemption

rows.note: Maximum Maryland estate tax, as a share of the taxable estate above the exemption.
rows.source_title: Maryland Code, Tax-General § 7-309: Estate tax
rows.label: Estate tax: top rate

rows.note: Of the clear value of property passing to heirs other than the exempt close relatives. Exempt: spouse, children and their descendants (and their spouses), parents, grandparents, brothers and sisters.

rows.label: Inheritance tax rate

rows.section: Maryland excise taxes on cigarettes and motor fuel
rows.note: State cigarette tax. Other tobacco products: 60% of the wholesale price (different rates for cigars and pipe tobacco).

rows.label: Cigarette tax (per pack of 20 cigarettes)

rows.section: Maryland vehicle taxes and registration fees
rows.note: Vehicle excise (titling) tax on the fair market value of the vehicle. Rental vehicles 3.5%; minimum tax $100.
